about: The public keys this repository's agents sign their commits with (Dinis, 19 Nov 2026 ~01:05 UTC, Website board/guidance/2026-11-19-signed-commits-paid-search-and-free-embeds.md section 2). Each entry: the agent, the Claude session it works in, and the public half of its SSH signing key. scripts/check-signatures.mjs reads this file at each commit's parent. A new session handing over the role adds its own entry and marks the old one superseded, with the time. Public halves only; the signing half never leaves the session.

keys.also: the agent's sgit key bundle: team/keys/events-b-promptugal.json
